class.name: GodotDoctorClassNameQueryResult
class.brief_description: Holds the results for a class name query. Used by [ValidationCondition] to determine if a script has a class name and what it is.

method.name: _init
method.description: Initializes the result. [param script_found] indicates whether a script was found on the target node. [param class_name_found] is the class name found in the script, or an empty [StringName] if none was found.

members.member: Whether a script was found on the queried node.
The class name found in the script, or an empty [StringName] if none was found.
Whether a non-empty class name was found in the script.
